summary: Boot intro feature verified end-to-end. Backend: 6/6 pytest cases pass — GET /api/settings returns intro_type + intro_has_video with defaults; PUT persists intro_type=neon; POST /api/intro/video (small mp4) sets intro_has_video=True; GET streams video content-type; POST >10MB returns 413; DELETE removes video and flips intro_has_video=False (subsequent GET returns 404). Frontend (Playwright, single browser context, live preview URL): boot-intro shows on fresh session; boot-skip button dismisses; click-anywhere dismisses; sessionStorage sx_intro_shown=1 suppresses on reload; clearing sessionStorage brings it back; localStorage sx_intro_off=1 suppresses on fresh session; Settings intro-manager shows all 4 cards (tengoku/kanji/neon/ink); intro-preview-kanji renders overlay + can be skipped; intro-choose-neon persists and next fresh session plays the neon animation (visually confirmed 'STATIONEXUS' neon + 電 起 動 kanji); Home focused-title, category tabs and ambience autoplay work after dismissal; ZERO console errors during the whole run. Cleanup done: settings reset to intro_type='tengoku' and DELETE /api/intro/video 200.
critical_code_review_comments: BootIntro useEffect deps list intentionally disabled ESLint — fine for one-shot mount, but note that changing `type` prop after mount will not restart timer (acceptable given usage).

IntroManager: toggling intro-enabled writes localStorage synchronously and updates state — good, but the checkbox reads localStorage only at first mount; if changed in another tab it won't reflect. Minor.
Server MAX_INTRO_BYTES enforced AFTER reading full body into memory; acceptable given 10MB cap but could be streamed for future larger caps.
test_credentials: Admin PIN 1234 (localStorage sx_admin=1, sx_pin=1234) used for admin-only Settings actions
seed_data_creation: Ephemeral: uploaded ~1KB dummy mp4 to /api/intro/video then deleted; PUT intro_type=neon then reset to tengoku
context_for_next_testing_agent: Boot intro backend + frontend fully validated. Tests are idempotent and self-clean: /app/backend/tests/test_intro.py resets settings.intro_type='tengoku' and deletes intro video in fixture teardown. Re-run with: pytest /app/backend/tests/test_intro.py -v. For UI, remember to preset sessionStorage.setItem('sx_intro_shown','1') if you want to bypass the 3s overlay when testing non-intro Home flows.
